first_appearance_definition: The first visible portion within the clip that is identifiable and can be temporally matched to that subject; frame numbering starts at 0.

entities.name: green soccer field
entities.identification: A continuous green-grass playing area, with the end line, goal area, and more distant white field lines visible.

entities.name: sideline advertising barrier
entities.identification: Long advertising boards arranged along the perimeter of the field, with white and green backgrounds and text and graphics.

entities.name: group of players in green clothing
entities.identification: A group of players wearing green shirts and shorts and white knee-high socks; in the first frame, they include one lying beside a goalpost of Object D, one standing in the goal area, and one in the lower part of the image.

entities.name: group of players in dark clothing
entities.identification: Two players wearing blue-and-black vertically striped shirts, dark shorts, and socks; one runs toward the advertising area beyond the end line, and the other has number 22 on the back.

entities.name: Person D
entities.identification: The goalkeeper wearing bright orange clothing, lying beside the far goalpost of Object D in the first frame and subsequently propping up the upper body.

entities.name: soccer ball
entities.identification: A small white spherical object inside the net of Object D, moving through the net area toward the bottom of the image.

entities.name: Object D
entities.identification: The white goal at the end where Person D is located, positioned on the image-left, with a light-colored net attached behind the frame.

entities.name: gray tiered stands
entities.identification: The gray stepped seating, partitions, and railing structure on the image-left, above the off-field passageway.

entities.name: off-field group of people in vests
entities.identification: Background personnel around the perimeter of the field wearing orange or bright yellow vests with dark lower garments, including seated and standing members.

entities.name: off-field gray rigid passageway
entities.identification: The gray rigid ground extending along the lower edge of the stands, between the stands and the sideline facilities.

entities.name: white advertising surface beyond the end line
entities.identification: The white-background advertising areas beyond the end line on both sides of Object D, with large black lettering and red areas.
